moa.t: Raises plasma osmolality, drawing water out of brain tissue, osmotic diuresis

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Mannitol, IV, 1.5–2 g/kg as a 20% solution over 30–60 minutes.
Mannitol, IV, 250 mg/kg administered over 30–60 minutes.
Mannitol, IV, 250 mg/kg administered over 30–60 minutes. · Do not repeat without consulting a paediatrician.
Mannitol, IV, 250 mg/kg administered over 30–60 minutes. · Do not exceed two doses without consulting with a specialist.

dosing.h: Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) and Neuro- Protection in the ICU

items.t: Mannitol, IV, 0.5–1 g/kg over 10 minutes, may be repeated 6 hourly.

contraindications.t: Severe heart failure or pulmonary oedema

adverse_effects.t: Fluid overload initially then hypovolaemia, electrolyte disturbance, acute kidney injury, rebound rise in intracranial pressure

monitoring.t: Urine output, electrolytes, serum osmolality where available
